headline: A 1994 executive order limits how Americans can take part in activities that help spread dangerous weapons.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets rules that restrict United States persons from taking part in activities that help spread weapons. No summary was provided, so details such as which weapons are covered, what specific actions are banned, and what penalties apply cannot be confirmed from the source material.

who_it_affects.group: United States persons, such as citizens and US-based companies
who_it_affects.how: They face limits on taking part in activities tied to the spread of weapons.
